primaryRightsEvidence.finding: Creative/editorial game commentary and specified platform monetization are covered conditionally; individual consumers only. Official Nintendo promotional material is included. Third-party rights remain separate.
primaryRightsEvidence.application: Supports a conditional Nintendo-game-content basis, not another recorder's blanket permission or a guarantee for our final edit.

primaryRightsEvidence.application: Available official game-content guidance, subject to actual use and regional/account context. Does not clear Arekkz's authored guide or music.
